On Mon, Oct 17, 2022 at 5:52 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks so much, Sophia!
On my end, happy to do an internal meeting on IRC with the members. Happy to be of service to you. I think
maybe we could do an hour before or after the public meeting.
I also think this issue is important to discuss at a high level in a public meeting - and could be raised as part of
broader DRG / AC conversation. I just don't know how it cannot be raised. There are ways to raise it and elevate it
without talking about the Council or anything internal at all. We at USAID are trying to strengthen the resilience in
the information and media space, partner with the tech sector to ensure tech supports democracy, and civil society
broadly to support democracies globally, address corruption, etc. Full disclosure - I am also giving a public talk on
this topic this week for the DOD audience.
cheers, Vera
On Mon, Oct 17, 2022 at 2:43 PM Sophia Lajaunie <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi all,
Thanks for a very helpful call earlier today. Wanted to circle back with next steps based on our conversation.
1.As discussed, we'd love if you could please share with us the following items,by Thursday COB if possible (so
we can then get this back out to the members):
a- The top 3-5 questions/challenges within the DRG & anti-corruption portfolios that you would like the ACVFA
working group on this to focus on (for now at least). As a reminder you had already shared these questions in the
initial draft workplan, in case they remain similar.
b- Which specific members (full list here) you are most interested in working with, see as resources to your work,
and/or have relationships with.
2. As part of the upcoming public meeting in early December (date TBC this week), we will likely have 2 separate
panels on different priority issues (speakers would include ACVFA members, potential outside experts/leaders,
local actors, etc.), one of which will fall in the DRG/AC umbrella. MDM is an option but may be too contentious
given the domestic context as discussed -- are there other key issues within this space you would like to see

As you saw there was clearly a lot of interest on the issue of dis/misinformation. This will likely be a
main issue the committee works on (likely a smaller subgroup of members would focus on it), and l'd
love to set some time to hear your thoughts on this as well as your reactions to the meeting in
general. I am also restructuring our workplan proposal based on Friday's convo.
1 am also adding +Vera Zakem here following the Administrator's note in a recent DWW (attached)
regarding a potential presentation on the Information Resilience Council at the next ACVFA meeting.
Would love to discuss this and the IRC in general, potential opportunities for collaboration/support,
etc.
Let me know which days might work best this week or next and happy to send a calendar invite.
Please also of course add anyone else who should join. Also including +Donald Steinberg +Jodi
Herman lead advisors for ACVFA.
Thanks all very much!
Sophia
